title: Learn-then-escalate: Chronological rise from first drop to 7-floor streak and topple

clips.why: Quickly establishes the sliding block and tap-to-drop mechanic.
Shows the first two successful drops and overhang slicing up to 2/20 floors.
Rewards accurate timing with the 'PERFECT!' drop golden flash.
Escalates difficulty as the tower climbs to 7/20 and shifts from blue to purple.
Delivers the tense alignment attempt and 'MISSED!' block tumble.
Shows the run stats summary and instant 'TRY AGAIN' tap.
Captures the fast restart and immediate first-drop miss.
Closes with the Sky Stack end card and INSTALL button.
